description.zh:
把 AI Passport 变成随身宝可梦冒险。听完大木博士的介绍，从御三家或皮卡丘中选择伙伴，携带出行积累探索机会，在森林、山洞、海边和电站寻找前151只宝可梦。

掌握投球时机，收集不同伙伴与闪光形态，组建六人队伍。照料会影响成长和探索收益，进化、图鉴与成就还能带来道具奖励。十二位地图训练家可重复切磋，低等级队员有经验追赶，随后挑战道馆、四天王、冠军与赤红。

战斗自动从已学招式中出招，技能随成长解锁，无需管理PP或遗忘技能。配有像素动画、场景音乐、音量与静音控制，支持自动熄屏。探索补给满格即可增加一次机会，最多保留24次。

探索根据周边 Wi-Fi 环境变化判断移动，不是真实计步；体能随设备运行时间恢复。当前支持191种招式，并非完整金银复刻。非官方同人项目，名称、画面与音乐的素材来源见源码说明。

# PokeWalk 9 月 10 日更新说明

上次社区提交后，这一轮主要根据大家的试玩反馈，调整了按键操作、成长反馈和日常游玩的节奏，也修复了“妙蛙种子 16 级还不能进化”的问题。

## 操作统一，减少误触

- 统一为 **A 上、B 下、C 确认，长按 B 返回**，不再根据页面选项数量切换操作方式。
- 修复 C 键意外返回、长按后又触发短按等问题。战斗中的逃跑和认输需要再次确认。
- 捕获时 A/B 切换精灵球，按下 C 立即投球，松开不会重复投球。
- 队伍、仓库、探索活动和联盟补给的入口同步适配；网页预览采用相同操作。

## 升级、学招和经验反馈更完整

- 恢复主页经验条，与探索补给进度分开显示。
- 训练家／道馆战斗补上经验条，换宠后同步切换；战后增加经验增长动画和获得经验数字。
- 升级后展示宝可梦、等级变化、新学会的招式及音效。队员通过分享经验升级也会提示，一次升多级不会漏掉期间学会的招式。
- 招式依然自动学会，不增加手动学习、遗忘或 PP 管理。升级提示不会打断捕获动画、道馆对话和领奖流程。

## 等级到了，就能进化

- 等级进化改为按实际等级判断，不再额外要求亲密度和探索值。
- 妙蛙种子 16 级可进化妙蛙草，妙蛙草 32 级可进化妙蛙花；已有存档超过门槛也直接适用，不用再升一级。
- 达到条件后，升级通知会提醒；将伙伴设为队首，在「照料 → 进化」按 C 确认即可。未达条件时显示所需等级。
- 保留手动确认和进化动画，玩家可以选择暂不进化；道具进化仍使用对应道具。

## 让冒险可以慢慢玩

重复挑战开始与全局体能联动，队伍共享体能，每只宝可梦的战斗 HP 仍独立：

| 行动 | 消耗 |
|---|---|
| 普通探索 | 5 点体能＋1 次探索机会 |
| 路线训练家切磋 | 5 点体能，不扣探索机会 |
| 道馆、强化重赛、赤红 | 10 点体能 |
| 四天王与冠军 | 整轮 20 点，入场扣一次 |

- 已发现的野怪战斗、捕获不新增入场消耗。
- 体能上限 100，开机或熄屏待机每 5 分钟恢复 1 点；挑战页面显示费用、余额和预计等待时间。完全关机期间暂不恢复。
- 训练家战败不再额外扣 20 点体能，改为扣 5 点心情，不扣经验；认输不退入场费用。
- 低体能不再额外降低战斗伤害；饱食和心情仍参与养成效果。

## 修复与存档兼容

- 体能不足 5 点时禁止玩耍，仍可消耗树果喂食。
- 修复体能小数取整导致“显示够用，实际进不去”的问题。
- 完善保存失败重试，避免重复扣体能、重复发经验。
- 保持原存档格式，无需重新开始游戏。
description.en:
Turn AI Passport into a pocket Pokémon adventure. Meet Professor Oak, choose one of the three original starters or Pikachu, and build up exploration chances as you travel. Search forests, caves, the coast and a power station for the first 151 Pokémon.

Time your throws, discover shiny Pokémon and assemble a party of six. Caring for your partners helps their growth and exploration, while evolution, Pokédex milestones and achievements unlock item rewards. Train against twelve repeatable route opponents, help lower-level teammates catch up, then take on Gym Leaders, the Elite Four, the Champion and Red.

Battles automatically choose from learned moves. New moves unlock as partners grow, with no PP management or forced forgetting. Enjoy pixel animations, scene music, adjustable volume, mute and automatic screen sleep. Each full exploration supply bar grants another chance, with room for 24.

Movement is inferred from changes in nearby Wi-Fi, rather than step counting; stamina recovers while the device is running. This version supports 191 moves and is not a complete Gold/Silver recreation. An unofficial fan project; artwork, music and naming sources are documented in the repository.

September 10 update

Controls: A moves up, B moves down, C confirms; hold B to go back. All menus now use the same controls. Fixed unintended back actions and taps firing after a long press. Escape and surrender require confirmation. During capture, A/B change balls and pressing C immediately locks the throw timing.

Growth: restored the home EXP bar alongside exploration supply. Trainer and Gym battles now show EXP bars that follow the active partner, with animated EXP rewards after battle. Level-up notices show level changes and newly learned moves, including teammates receiving shared EXP and moves learned across multiple levels. Moves remain automatic, with no PP or forgetting. Notices wait for capture, dialogue and reward sequences.

Evolution: level-based evolution now requires only the appropriate level, with no extra friendship or exploration threshold. Bulbasaur can evolve at level 16 and Ivysaur at 32. Existing partners already above the threshold qualify immediately. Level-up notices remind you when evolution is available. Set the partner as your party leader, open Care, select Evolution and press C. Evolution stays optional; item evolutions still use their corresponding items.

Daily pacing: repeatable battles now use shared stamina. Normal exploration costs 5 stamina and one exploration chance; route trainers cost 5 stamina without using a chance; Gyms, rematches and Red cost 10. The Elite Four and Champion cost 20 for the entire run, charged once on entry. Previously discovered wild encounters have no additional entry fee. Stamina is shared by the party; battle HP remains individual.

Stamina caps at 100 and restores one point every five minutes while running or in screen-off standby. Menus show costs, balance and estimated recovery time. Recovery while fully powered off is not yet supported. Trainer defeat now reduces mood by 5 without an additional 20-stamina penalty or EXP loss; surrender does not refund entry costs. Low stamina no longer reduces battle damage; food and mood still affect care bonuses.

Fixes: playing requires at least 5 stamina, while feeding with berries remains available. Corrected rounded stamina balances that appeared sufficient for entry. Improved save-failure retries to prevent duplicate charges or EXP awards. The save format remains compatible; no new game is required.
